scope: One bounded official-GitHub documentation audit of the automatically generated attestation for immutable releases, limited to independent addressability/verifiability, subject identity, post-release/post-repository deletion retention or discoverability, quota/plan evidence, and whether the attestation closes Part108's deleted-release tombstone reconciliation gap without an extra attestation-creation write.

public_sources.title: Immutable releases
public_sources.observation: GitHub documents that creating an immutable release automatically generates a cryptographically verifiable release attestation containing the release tag, commit SHA, and release assets. The same page documents tag-name non-reuse after immutable-release deletion and after repository delete/recreate.

public_sources.title: Verifying the integrity of a release
public_sources.observation: The documented CLI verification path is `gh release verify RELEASE-TAG` (and `verify-asset`) in the repository containing the release; the web path inspects the extant release page. The retrieved documentation does not document a release-attestation ID/URI or deleted-release lookup path.

public_sources.title: Immutable releases are now generally available
public_sources.observation: GitHub says immutable-release attestations are signed, use the Sigstore bundle format, and can verify authenticity/integrity outside GitHub. This establishes portable verification format, but not service-side discovery or retention after release/repository deletion.

public_sources.title: Artifact attestations
public_sources.observation: For ordinary public-repository artifact attestations, GitHub documents a stored Sigstore bundle plus a public transparency-log copy. This is only a comparison control: the retrieved immutable-release documentation does not explicitly state that automatically generated release attestations have the same independently queryable transparency-log retention semantics, so this property is not transferred to release attestations.

inferences.portable_verification_is_not_discoverabi: A Sigstore-compatible bundle can be verified outside GitHub if the verifier possesses it, but the retrieved official docs do not establish how a stateless future recurring-Chat invocation can rediscover that release-attestation bundle after the immutable release or repository has been deleted.
inferences.reason: The subject identity is strong enough to bind tag/commit/assets, but no documented stable attestation identity or post-deletion discovery/retention contract was found for automatically generated release attestations. Therefore it cannot yet serve as the machine-checkable tombstone reconciliation witness required by Part108.
inferences.artifact_attestation_transparency_log_no: The public transparency-log statement retrieved for artifact attestations is not treated as proof for immutable-release attestations because the release-attestation docs did not explicitly connect their automatic release attestation to the same independently discoverable log semantics.

phase1_result.new_positive: Automatic immutable-release attestations remove the need for a separate attestation-creation write and bind the release tag, commit SHA and assets in a Sigstore-verifiable record.
phase1_result.new_falsification: The retrieved official verification surface remains release/tag-centric and does not document an independently addressable attestation identity or post-release/post-repository deletion retrieval path. Portable verification therefore does not close service-side anti-rollback reconciliation for a stateless future invocation.
phase1_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A documented zero-quota machine-checkable lookup/retention path for the immutable-release attestation after release deletion or repository delete/recreate, or a different service-side witness whose stable identity and anti-ABA retention are independently queryable without requiring a richer-mode/manual executor or extra paid/quota-bearing infrastructure.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.reason: The release attestation is automatic and no finite per-month generation quota was documented in the retrieved release-attestation pages, but plan eligibility and post-deletion retention/discoverability at quota=0 were not documented; acceptance therefore fails closed.

scope_guard: No release, tag, repository setting, attestation, scheduler, O/downstream/other-worker state, or external hosted compute was mutated. No property of ordinary artifact attestations is generalized to automatic immutable-release attestations without explicit documentation.
continuation: Part110: execute one bounded official-GitHub public-source leaf on GitHub's attestation retrieval surfaces as a possible service-side witness. Audit the REST/CLI attestation lookup contract for subject-digest or bundle retrieval, and specifically whether an automatically generated immutable-release attestation is covered by that API, remains queryable after release deletion or repository delete/recreate, exposes a stable repository-independent identity or transparency-log locator, and has zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota or paid-plan dependency. Do not infer release-attestation coverage from ordinary artifact-attestation APIs; require an explicit official connection. If no such connection or post-deletion retention contract is documented, fail closed and checkpoint the next candidate without executing it in the same invocation.
